checks.name: types
checks.cmd: cd web && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run types && git diff --exit-code -- src/lib/api-types.ts && echo 'types clean + api-types unchanged'

checks.name: build
checks.cmd: cd web && npm run build && size=$(gzip -c dist/assets/index-*.js | wc -c); test "$size" -le 409600 && echo "initial JS: $((size / 1024)) KB gzip <= 400 KB"

checks.name: screenshots
checks.cmd: count390=$(ls verification/screenshots/web/*-390.png 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); count1440=$(ls verification/screenshots/web/*-1440.png 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); total=$(ls verification/screenshots/web/*.png | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$total" -ge 10 && test "$count390" -ge 5 && test "$count1440" -ge 5 && echo "screenshots: $total files (390px: $count390, 1440px: $count1440)"
